patch_description: This version keeps direct-demand rewards as the main signal and adds pressure-adjusted two-hop rewards. For each positive-demand OD pair, route quality determines how its reward is distributed among candidate intermediates; the distribution is not uniform. The total reward across those routes is capped at 28% of that pair’s direct-link reward, limiting the influence of indirect paths while still favoring less congested relays and links. Degree penalties remain the evaluator’s responsibility.
